title: Adachi residents’ 9 November march against Aleph and demand that it dissolve/leave
reason: The public march of 110 people was directed at the private religious organization Aleph, and the protest letter was delivered to its facility. The source cites a state restriction as support but does not demand action from Japan’s national or local government.
notes: Excluded on target grounds, not turnout. The official ward report distinguishes an existing state restriction from the protesters’ demand to Aleph.

title: Sogo & Seibu Ikebukuro labor strike reported as a possible November lead
reason: Search results for the specific strike date the event to 31 August 2023, outside the assigned month/year. It concerned a private company sale and does not support a November 2024 state-target protest.
notes: The Q005 query was a follow-up to identify a possible Seibu/department-store false positive. Result headers, not article bodies, were captured.
